$comment: Example skill definition — pre-deployment safety check.
This skill runs a multi-step verification pipeline before any
deployment operation. It checks build health, test results, and
environment configuration to catch issues early.
The 'conditional' field on a step makes it run only when the
condition string matches the current context.
name: deploy-check
description: Pre-deployment safety check — verify build, tests, and env before shipping

steps.description: Run the project build and confirm zero errors
Execute all tests and verify pass rate meets threshold
Validate that required env vars and secrets are set for the target environment
Confirm a rollback strategy exists (previous deploy tag, revert commit, etc.)
Summarize check results and surface any warnings
